narrow: siRNA loading onto RISC involved in RNA interference
siRNA loading onto RISC involved in gene silencing by small RNA
related: gene silencing by RNA, small RNA loading onto RISC

definition: The process in which a single-stranded small RNA is incorporated within the RNA-initiated silencing complex (RISC). The assembly includes the maturation of the small RNA, the stabilization of the complex by accessory proteins of the RISC complex, duplex separation and the release of the second strand, forming a base-pairing complement complex that mediates gene silencing by small RNA.
label: RISC complex assembly
